verdict.rationale: Apple's own Mac Help lists a 'Tile app windows' topic, so built-in window tiling is a documented first-party capability. A community tip adds that double-clicking a window edge or corner moves it to the screen edge or fills the screen without entering full-screen mode. Third-party tools like Moom are user workarounds and earn no credit; missing for 10: documentation of the tiling behavior itself, evidence of predefined multi-window layouts or arrangements, snap gestures or keyboard shortcuts, and independent hands-on corroboration of tiling.
